def densify(knots, step=1.5):
    knots = np.asarray(knots, float)
    ds = np.hypot(np.diff(knots[:, 0]), np.diff(knots[:, 1]))
    t = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(np.maximum(ds, 0.001))]
    ts = np.linspace(0, t[-1], max(2, int(np.ceil(t[-1] / step)) + 1))
    return np.stack([CubicSpline(t, knots[:, j], bc_type='natural')(ts) for j in range(3)], axis=-1)


def generate():

    s.record_start()
